svg.aria-label: Hello, I'm Aksan, someone who has to know how a thing works before I'm comfortable using it. When I build something like a multithreaded process manager in C, I end up following its mutexes and spinlocks down to the assembly. My thesis started the same way, from my own intuition about memory and confidence in language models. I like reasoning from first principles. More than once I've worked my way to an idea only to find it already in the literature, which taught me to read earlier and build on what's there. Where I'm headed: a research-capable, systems-aware, full-stack AI engineer.
